创作一幅从大腿中部或大腿上部至头部的戏剧性编辑风格人像，场景位于巨大的粗野主义科幻环境中。采用略微低机位和受控的 10-18 度荷兰角。姿态应具有感性、自信和挑衅感，但不要规定唯一姿势。保持面部、躯干和轮廓清晰可读，不显示脚部。

角色直接暴露在暴雨中。表现清晰可见的降雨、雨滴、湿润皮肤、潮湿的头发或材质、雨水流淌、雾气、水洼、反光建筑以及逆光雨丝，使雨水在物理上融入场景。

角色必须明确为成年人。画面应得体且非露骨，所有私密部位必须完全遮盖。女性角色穿着窄版半透明抹胸上衣，以及源自角色设计语言的极低腰、宽松、超大廓形、未扣上的垮裤；造型可以大胆，但必须完全遮盖。男性角色保持上身裸露，除非必须保留永久性身份特征的躯干元素；穿着源自角色设计语言的极低腰、宽松、超大廓形、未扣上的垮裤；造型可以大胆，但必须完全遮盖。若服装造型发生冲突，必须保留永久性身份特征服装、盔甲、面具、标记、珠宝、义肢、机械义体和非人类特征。

构建由巨型板块、悬空桥梁、竖井、楼梯、平台、机械、标识和远景结构组成的广阔粗野主义科幻环境。让建筑反映角色的形状、符号、材质、颜色、解剖特征、盔甲或文化元素。使用明亮得多的外部区域或远处空间，形成强烈的图形化逆光。

采用欧洲科幻漫画式的手绘墨线表现：粗粝的钢笔线条、稀疏排线、松散的构造线、半写实解剖、强烈透视、受控的透视缩短和扁平赛璐璐色调。

加入 1970 至 1980 年代复古印刷质感：老化纸张颗粒、不均匀墨色、褪色色彩、擦痕、斑点、轻微洇墨、套色误差、破旧标识和风化表面。

使用压暗的阴影、窄幅轮廓光、湿润表面高光、发光雾气和逆光雨丝，营造神秘、感性和反乌托邦氛围。画面比例为 9:18。
items.contentEnglish:
Use the supplied image as the absolute authority for the character's identity, species, anatomy, proportions, facial structure, silhouette, hairstyle and head shape, gender presentation, expression, markings, colors, materials, motifs, accessories, prosthetics, cybernetics, masks, and other distinctive traits. Preserve unmistakable recognizability. If an eye is hidden or covered in the reference, keep it hidden or covered.

Extend the character's palette, symbols, materials, geometry, patterns, cultural and technological cues, and design language across the entire image, including clothing, architecture, signage, lighting, and atmosphere. The background must be uniquely designed for this character and never generic.

Create a dramatic mid-thigh or upper-thigh-to-head editorial portrait in a monumental brutalist sci-fi environment. Use a slightly low viewpoint with a controlled 10-18 degree Dutch angle. The pose should feel sensual, confident, and provocative, but do not prescribe one exact pose. Keep the face, torso, and silhouette clearly readable. Do not show the feet.

The character is directly exposed to heavy rain. Show visible rainfall, droplets, wet skin, damp hair or materials, runoff, mist, puddles, reflective architecture, and backlit rain streaks. Make the rain feel physically integrated into the scene.

The character must be unmistakably adult. Keep the image tasteful and non-explicit, with all intimate areas fully covered. For a female character, use a narrow semi-sheer bandeau top and extremely low-rise, loose, oversized, baggy, unbuttoned pants derived from the character's design language; keep the styling daring but fully covered. For a male character, keep the torso topless unless a permanent identity-defining torso element must remain, and use extremely low-rise, loose, oversized, baggy, unbuttoned pants derived from the character's design language; keep the styling daring but fully covered. Preserve permanent identity-defining garments, armor, masks, markings, jewelry, prosthetics, cybernetics, and non-human features where they conflict with the styling changes.

Create a vast character-specific brutalist sci-fi environment of slabs, suspended bridges, shafts, stairs, platforms, machinery, signage, and distant structures. Echo the character's shapes, symbols, materials, colors, anatomy, armor, or cultural motifs throughout the architecture. Use a much brighter exterior or distant space for strong graphic backlighting.

Render it as a hand-inked European sci-fi bande dessinée with scratchy pen lines, sparse crosshatching, loose construction marks, semi-realistic anatomy, strong perspective, controlled foreshortening, and flat cel-shaded tones.

Add a distressed 1970s-1980s retro-print finish: aged paper grain, imperfect ink, faded pigments, scuffs, speckling, subtle bleed, registration errors, worn signage, and weathered surfaces.

Use crushed shadows, narrow rim light, wet-surface highlights, glowing mist, and backlit rain for a mysterious, sensual, dystopian atmosphere. Use a 9:18 aspect ratio.

items.title: GPT Image 2 东方剪纸桂林山水天窗
items.summary: 以“她在桂林山水之间打开一扇天窗”为主题的东方女性梦境立体剪纸作品提示词，强调峰林、湖面与巨型圆窗的三重空间。
items.contentChinese:
9:16竖版，现代东方女性梦境立体剪纸艺术，modern oriental papercut art，layered paper cut illustration，dimensional paper sculpture，intricate paper carving，paper diorama，poetic female dreamscape，contemporary oriental art poster。

主题为“她在桂林山水之间打开一扇天窗”。

一位视觉年龄约24岁的东方成年女性，清冷空灵、安静清醒，独自站在纸雕山水之间的临水圆形观景高台上。人物清秀鹅蛋脸，明亮杏眼，神情柔和而专注，身体侧背对镜头，微微抬头看向远方巨大的圆形纸窗。黑色长发半披半挽，发丝与细长藤蔓纸带自然连接，佩戴浅金小花与月牙发饰。

人物身穿青绿、月白相间的多层纸艺长裙，裙摆带水波、峰林、云纹和细密花枝镂空结构，外层披帛轻薄修长，在山谷清风中向身后自然飘动。服装具有明显纸张厚度、纤维纹理、细密裁切边缘、轻微折痕和精致浅金描边。

画面采用圆窗窥梦式构图。前景是一座从山体边缘伸出的圆形纸艺观景台，带精致镂空栏杆、曲线台阶、纸雕花枝与少量月白花朵。人物位于观景台左侧偏小位置，只作为辽阔山水中的情绪锚点。

中景是一片开阔、安静的纸雕湖面，从人物脚下向画面深处延伸。湖面采用多层浅青、湖蓝与月白纸片构成，水纹像被手工裁切出的细长弧线层层铺开，具有明显的纸雕浮层结构与细腻反光。湖面上只出现少量极小纸船，其中一艘带东方亭篷的小船位于右侧中景，另一艘更小的舟影位于远处，加强尺度与纵深。

湖面两侧耸立大量桂林喀斯特式纸雕群峰。山峰细长、陡峭、层层错落，从近景深墨青峰体逐渐过渡到远景青绿、雾青和月白轮廓，形成明显的近深远浅空间关系。所有山峰都由多层纸片叠加而成，边缘带浅金细线与纸张纤维纹理，不要写实岩石质感。

画面中上部是一扇极其巨大的圆形纸雕天窗，悬浮或嵌入群峰之间，尺度远大于人物。圆窗由数层象牙白、月白与淡青色纸环组成，边缘带精细藤蔓、花枝、云纹和镂空植物纹样。圆窗内部不是普通空洞，而像另一重天地正在被打开。

透过巨大圆窗，可以继续看见更加遥远的纸雕峰林、云海、晨光与飞鸟，形成“窗后还有山河”的第二重世界。远处群峰逐渐消失在明亮薄雾和天光中，使整个圆窗像一个通往另一层山水梦境的入口。

梦境意象包括：喀斯特群峰、湖面、纸船、飞鸟、云层、巨型圆窗。所有人物、山峰、水面、花枝、船只、云层与圆窗都必须统一为高完成度立体纸雕语言。

整体色彩方案为青绿、墨青、月白、浅金为主，少量淡粉点缀。近景群峰使用深墨青与孔雀青，中景山水使用青绿与湖蓝，远景逐渐过渡到淡青、月白和暖白。浅金用于圆窗边缘、衣缘、水纹与山脊高光，淡粉只用于极少量远岸花树或近景花朵。整体颜色比传统水墨稍微鲜明，但保持清透、高级、安静，不灰蒙、不脏绿、不统一偏蓝。

光线采用柔和明亮的清晨天光，从巨大圆窗后方和右上方斜照进来。圆窗内部成为整幅画面最明亮的区域，天光沿湖面向前延伸，在人物侧脸、肩部、长发、裙摆、水面和山峰边缘形成细腻轮廓光。纸雕山峰与水面边缘轻微透光，暗部仍保持青绿和墨青纸张纹理。

强化真实纸艺质感：清晰纸张纤维、纸层厚度、手工裁切边缘、轻微折痕、层间柔和投影、镂空纹样与半透明薄纸边缘。不要普通CG山水，不要真人站在剪纸背景中。

整体构图重点突出“峰林—湖面—巨型圆窗”三重空间：人物很小，湖面宽阔，山峰层层延伸，圆窗巨大而遥远。画面具有东方山水的留白感，同时拥有梦境入口般的神秘与史诗尺度。

整体情绪为：清醒、空灵、安静、辽阔、发现另一重天地。画面像一件高完成度的大型东方山水纸雕艺术装置，而不是普通桂林旅游插画。

负面提示词：真人摄影，普通动漫，塑料3D，树脂，黏土，儿童手工，普通山水插画，旅游宣传海报，写实岩石山峰，人物过大，人物特写，圆窗太小，湖面过窄，峰林层次不足，纸船过多，建筑过多，元素拥挤，没有纵深，没有留白，整体灰蒙，脏绿色，统一蓝色滤镜，暗部死黑，纸层混乱，纸张边缘模糊，人物与背景材质割裂，文字，Logo，水印。
items.contentEnglish:
9:16 vertical composition, modern oriental female dreamlike dimensional papercut art, modern oriental papercut art, layered paper cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate paper carving, paper diorama, poetic female dreamscape, contemporary oriental art poster.

Theme: “She opens a skylight among the Guilin mountains and waters.”

An oriental adult woman of about 24 visual age, cool, ethereal, calm, and clear-minded, standing alone on a circular waterside viewing platform within a paper-cut landscape. She has a refined oval face, bright almond eyes, and a soft, focused expression. Her body is turned slightly away from the camera as she looks up toward a huge circular paper window in the distance. Her black hair is half loose and half pinned up, naturally connected with thin vine-like paper ribbons, and decorated with small pale-gold flowers and a crescent moon hair ornament.

She wears a layered paper-art long dress in green and moon-white, with skirt details of water ripples, karst peaks, cloud motifs, and delicate floral cutouts. A light, elongated shawl drifts backward in the valley breeze. The clothing must show clear paper thickness, fiber texture, fine cut edges, slight creases, and delicate pale-gold outlining.

Use a dream-view composition through a circular window. In the foreground, a round paper-art viewing terrace extends from the mountain edge, with intricate cutout railings, curved steps, paper-carved flowers, and a few moon-white blossoms. The woman is placed small on the left side of the terrace, serving only as an emotional anchor within the vast landscape.

The middle ground is a wide, quiet paper-cut lake extending from her feet into the distance. The lake is built from layered pale cyan, lake blue, and moon-white paper pieces. Its ripples are formed by hand-cut slender arcs with visible layered paper structure and subtle reflections. Only a few tiny paper boats appear on the lake: one with an eastern pavilion canopy on the right side of the middle ground, and another even smaller silhouette farther away to strengthen scale and depth.

On both sides of the lake rise many Guilin karst-like paper-cut peaks. They are tall, slender, steep, and layered. The color transitions from deep dark cyan in the foreground to green-cyan, mist-cyan, and moon-white outlines in the distance, creating a strong near-deep-far-light spatial relationship. All peaks must be made of layered paper with pale-gold edge lines and paper fiber texture. Do not use realistic rock texture.

In the upper middle of the image, place an extremely large circular paper skylight, suspended among the peaks or embedded between them, much larger than the woman. It is formed from several rings of ivory white, moon white, and pale cyan paper, with delicate vine, flower, cloud, and cutout plant patterns along the rim. The circle is not an empty hole; it feels like another world opening.

Through the huge circular window, reveal even more distant paper-cut peaks, sea of clouds, morning light, and flying birds, forming a second world beyond the window. The far mountains fade into bright mist and daylight, making the circular opening feel like a gateway to another mountain-and-water dreamscape.

Dream motifs include karst peaks, lake, paper boats, birds, clouds, and a giant circular window. All figures, mountains, water, flowers, boats, clouds, and the window must be rendered in a consistent high-fidelity dimensional paper-cut language.

Use a palette dominated by green-cyan, dark cyan, moon white, and pale gold, with only a few subtle pale pink accents. The foreground peaks use deep dark cyan and peacock cyan, the middle landscape uses green-cyan and lake blue, and the distance gradually shifts to pale cyan, moon white, and warm white. Pale gold is used for the window rim, clothing edges, water highlights, and mountain ridges. Pale pink appears only in a few distant trees or nearby blossoms. The colors should be slightly more vivid than traditional ink painting, but still clear, elegant, calm, not muddy, not dirty green, and not uniformly blue.

Lighting is soft and bright morning daylight, coming diagonally from behind the huge circular window and from the upper right. The inside of the window is the brightest area of the whole image. The light stretches across the lake and creates delicate rim light on the woman's face, shoulder, hair, dress, water, and mountain edges. The paper mountains and water edges glow slightly, while shadows retain the green-cyan and dark-cyan paper texture.

Emphasize real paper-art texture: clear paper fibers, paper thickness, hand-cut edges, slight creases, soft inter-layer shadows, cutout patterns, and semi-translucent thin paper edges. Do not use ordinary CG landscapes, and do not place a real person against a paper-cut background.

The composition must emphasize the three spatial layers of peaks, lake, and giant circular window. The woman is small, the lake is wide, the peaks extend in layers, and the window is huge and distant. The image should have the emptiness of eastern landscape painting while also feeling like a mysterious, epic dream portal.

Overall mood: clear-minded, ethereal, quiet, expansive, and as if discovering another world. The image should feel like a high-end large-scale oriental mountain-and-water paper sculpture installation, not a typical Guilin tourism illustration.

Negative prompts: real photography, generic anime, plastic 3D, resin, clay, children's craft, ordinary landscape illustration, tourism poster, realistic rocky mountains, oversized character, close-up portrait, window too small, lake too narrow, insufficient mountain depth, too many paper boats, too many buildings, crowded elements, no depth, no negative space, overall gray haze, muddy green, uniform blue filter, dead-black shadows, messy paper layers, blurry paper edges, material mismatch between subject and background, text, logo, watermark.

items.title: 透明塑料袋里装着小号Q版角色的二次元插画提示词
items.summary: 保留原始二次元提示词：角色A提着透明塑料袋，袋中是坐在底部、带着不满表情的Q版角色B，整体为简洁背景的诙谐可爱插画。
items.contentChinese: 角色A casually 提着一个透明塑料袋，塑料袋由提手拎起。袋子里面坐着一个小号 Q 版的角色B，位置在袋底，表情是可爱又有点不满。整体画面要有诙谐、荒诞、可爱的互动感，采用干净的二次元插画风格，背景简单。
items.contentEnglish: Character A casually holds up a transparent plastic bag by the handles. Inside the bag sits a tiny chibi version of Character B at the bottom, with a cute annoyed expression. The overall image should feel funny, absurd, and adorable, in a clean anime illustration style with a simple background.

items.title: 水墨烟雾角色动态片头
items.summary: 一段15秒黑白水墨烟雾动态片头，五个角色依次凝聚与消散，并以烟雾文字呈现墨烟、江湖、机械、觉醒与 LANSEN。
items.contentChinese:
制作一段15秒电影级水墨烟雾艺术片头。
整体是一镜到底，没有剪辑，没有跳切，没有镜头切换。
场景：
纯白无限空间。
五个不同角色依次由黑色水墨烟雾凝聚形成。
所有角色都由流动的黑色墨烟组成，不是真人，不是实体。
黑色墨粒、烟雾丝线、液态墨汁不断流动。
烟雾始终保持运动：
头发、衣摆、披风、武器边缘持续由墨烟组成并不断散开、重新聚合。
镜头：
固定中景构图。
轻微电影级漂移。
不要快速运镜。
所有视觉变化来自墨烟变化。
时间节奏：
0-3秒：
第一张参考图片中的角色从右侧出现。
大量黑色墨烟从右向左流动，在空中凝聚成人物轮廓。
角色完全形成后保持轻微动作：
身体微微移动，衣服和头发由烟雾组成不断飘动。
左侧出现文字：
「墨烟」
文字必须由黑色水墨烟雾形成。
不是普通字幕。
不是后期贴图。
文字拥有真实厚度，
由浓密墨粒组成，
边缘不断散落成烟雾。
3-6秒：
第一个角色重新融化成黑色烟雾。
烟雾反方向流动，从左侧进入。
形成第二个角色。
右侧出现文字：
「江湖」
文字由流动墨烟凝聚形成。
文字与人物烟雾互相融合。
6-9秒：
第二个角色消散。
黑色墨烟重新组合成第三个角色。
左侧出现：
「机械」
文字从烟雾粒子中诞生。
保持水墨质感。
9-12秒：
第四个角色由烟雾形成。
右侧出现：
「觉醒」
文字随着烟雾流动出现。
字体厚重，具有东方艺术感。
12-15秒：
最后一个角色形成。
所有黑色墨烟汇聚到中央。
形成最终标题：
「LANSEN」
文字由巨大黑色墨云组成。
最后文字和烟雾一起缓慢消散。
视觉风格：
东方水墨艺术。
黑白高对比。
纯白背景。
黑色液态墨烟。
电影片头设计。
高级艺术展视觉。
AAA游戏宣传片质感。
要求：
文字必须清晰可读。
文字必须是中文或英文大字。
文字必须由墨烟组成。
人物轮廓保持参考图一致。
禁止：
不要普通字幕。
不要UI界面。
不要现代字体覆盖。
不要彩色。
不要动漫。
不要卡通。
不要真人。
不要突然切换。
不要静止画面。
不要随机文字。
不要乱码。
items.contentEnglish:
Create a 15-second cinematic ink-smoke art title sequence.
The entire sequence is one continuous shot, with no editing, no jump cuts, and no shot transitions.
Scene:
A pure white infinite space.
Five different characters sequentially condense and form from black ink smoke.
All characters are composed of flowing black ink smoke, not real people and not solid entities.
Black ink particles, smoke strands, and liquid ink continuously flow.
The smoke remains in constant motion:
Hair, garment hems, capes, and weapon edges continuously form from ink smoke while constantly dispersing and re-forming.
Camera:
Fixed medium-shot composition.
Subtle cinematic drift.
Do not use rapid camera movement.
All visual changes come from changes in the ink smoke.
Timing:
0-3 seconds:
The character from the first reference image appears from the right side.
Large amounts of black ink smoke flow from right to left, condensing in the air into the character's outline.
After the character fully forms, maintain subtle movement:
The body moves slightly, while the clothing and hair, composed of smoke, continuously drift.
Text appears on the left:
「墨烟」
The text must be formed from black ink smoke.
It must not be ordinary subtitles.
It must not be a post-production overlay.
The text has real thickness,
is composed of dense ink particles,
and its edges continuously scatter into smoke.
3-6 seconds:
The first character melts back into black smoke.
The smoke flows in the opposite direction, entering from the left side.
It forms the second character.
Text appears on the right:
「江湖」
The text condenses and forms from flowing ink smoke.
The text and the character's smoke merge with each other.
6-9 seconds:
The second character disperses.
The black ink smoke recombines into the third character.
Text appears on the left:
「机械」
The text emerges from smoke particles.

items.title: 瑞士现代主义磨砂玻璃身体碎片化海报提示词
items.summary: 以瑞士国际主义网格、磨砂玻璃分层和身体碎片化为核心的极简文化节海报提示词，适合角色匿名化再设计。
items.contentChinese:
瑞士现代主义 × 磨砂玻璃观念摄影 × 身体碎片化 × 极简文化节海报。

只保留角色最核心的身体轮廓或极少量能够辨识身份的剪影特征，不直接展示清晰五官和完整服装，将角色转换为匿名化的观念人体影像。

角色站在一整块乳白半透明磨砂玻璃或树脂板后方，身体保持近似直立，整体轮廓沿画面纵向延伸。让角色大部分身体与介质保持一定距离，因此形成宽阔、柔软、完全失焦的人形暗影；同时随机选择头部、手臂、手掌、膝部或腿部中的少量局部靠近或贴住磨砂表面，使这些区域从模糊剪影中转化成深黑、细长、清晰度更高的身体碎片。不要依靠五官、服装细节或直接角色展示建立画面，而是通过人体轮廓和局部形态表达角色存在。

采用竖版约2:3构图，角色主轴固定在中央偏左或中央区域，周围保留约一半以上大面积负空间。使用接近50—85mm的自然至中长焦视觉，中距离、眼平机位拍摄，不制造夸张广角透视。空间固定为“镜头—磨砂介质—角色”三层结构，以前景半透明板、局部清晰身体碎片、后方模糊人体剪影构成深度。

使用角色后方的大面积漫射背光，让光线穿过空间并被人体遮挡，再经过磨砂表面产生宽阔柔化阴影。整体保持高键奶灰白和浅青灰背景，角色局部压成近黑色，仅加入约5%的高纯度柠檬黄色作为视觉焦点。

版式固定采用瑞士国际主义网格设计：在角色旁边设置小型日期、地点、编号和文化活动说明文字，以极简无衬线字体形成清晰信息层级；一个短主标题使用柠檬黄色大字号排版，其余文字保持黑、白或浅灰。保持文字极锐利、摄影主体极柔化的质感冲突，并维持大面积留白、非对称平衡、低视觉噪音与印刷海报感，最终形成瑞士现代主义 × 半透明介质观念摄影 × 身体碎片化 × 极简文化节海报的稳定视觉体系。
items.contentEnglish:
Swiss modernism × frosted-glass conceptual photography × fragmented body × minimalist cultural festival poster.

Keep only the character’s core body contour or a very small number of silhouette features that can identify the subject. Do not directly show clear facial features or complete clothing. Transform the character into an anonymized conceptual human image.

Place the character behind a single sheet of milky, semi-transparent frosted glass or resin board, with the body kept nearly upright and the overall contour extending vertically through the frame. Keep most of the body at a distance from the translucent surface so it becomes a broad, soft, fully defocused human shadow. At the same time, randomly let a few parts such as the head, arms, hands, knees, or legs approach or touch the frosted surface, turning those areas from blurry silhouette into darker, narrower, sharper body fragments. Do not build the image through facial details, clothing details, or a direct character reveal; express the character’s presence through body contour and localized form.

Use a vertical 2:3 composition, with the main axis of the character placed near the center-left or center, leaving more than half the frame as large negative space. Use a natural to medium telephoto look of about 50 to 85mm, shot from a mid-distance, eye-level camera position, without exaggerated wide-angle perspective. Keep the space as a three-layer structure of camera, frosted medium, and character, creating depth with a translucent foreground panel, localized sharp body fragments, and a blurred human silhouette in the back.

Use large diffuse backlight behind the character so the light passes through the space, is blocked by the body, and then creates broad softened shadows through the frosted surface. Keep the overall palette high-key with milky gray white and pale cyan gray backgrounds, compress the character into near-black local forms, and add only about 5 percent high-saturation lemon yellow as the visual focal point.

Use a Swiss International Style grid layout: place small date, location, number, and cultural event copy beside the character in a minimalist sans-serif type hierarchy; set a short main title in large lemon-yellow type, while the remaining text stays black, white, or light gray. Maintain the contrast between extremely sharp text and very soft photographic subject, with large blank space, asymmetrical balance, low visual noise, and a printed poster feel, forming a stable visual system of Swiss modernism × translucent-medium conceptual photography × body fragmentation × minimalist cultural festival poster.

items.title: 暴雨中的弱小赤狐与内心九尾灵狐
items.summary: 暴雨原野中，一只浑身泥水的幼小赤狐继续前行，天空中浮现巨大九尾灵狐的精神化身，呈现成长与坚持的手绘水彩寓言。
items.contentChinese:
创作一幅具有强烈情绪感染力和成长寓意的手绘水彩叙事插画，主题为“暴雨中弱小的现实自己，与隐藏在内心深处的强大自己”。

【画幅与构图】
9:16 竖幅电影构图，所有内容处于同一个连续场景中，不是上下拼图，不是分镜，不是两幅画。
画面中只能出现一个现实主角和一个精神化的强大化身。
现实主角位于画面下方三分之一处，占整个画面约 15%，以自然侧面或四分之三侧面呈现；强大化身位于现实主角身后上方，占据画面上半部分约 60%，形成“小与大、现实与理想、实体与精神”的强烈反差。
现实主角与强大化身必须朝向同一方向，动作趋势相互呼应，轮廓和物种特征具有明确关联。

【现实主角表现】
暴雨笼罩着一片空旷荒凉的原野。一只幼小的赤狐正在泥泞积水中艰难向前。
它浑身被雨水彻底打湿，身体略微压低，头部微垂，脚步沉重，显得疲惫、狼狈、弱小而孤独，但没有停下，依然倔强地迎着风雨继续前进。
动作必须符合真实生物结构，四肢落点准确，身体重心自然，运动姿态连贯。湿透的毛发贴在身体上，并被强风轻微吹动。脚掌踏入浅水与泥泞，溅起细小而自然的水花，体现真实的重量感、地面阻力和暴雨环境。
不要微笑，不要卖萌，不要夸张哭泣。通过低头前行、身体压低和坚定迈步的姿态，表现疲惫、隐忍、不服输和继续坚持的力量。

【强大化身表现】
在现实主角身后上方的天空、雨幕、云层和雾气中，浮现出一个极其巨大的九尾灵狐化身。
它与现实主角拥有清晰的轮廓关联，但更加成熟、强壮、威严、自由而神圣。它昂首向前，身躯舒展，姿态坚定有力，可以呈现奔跑、跃起、展翅或静静守护的状态，如同现实主角尚未觉醒的真正力量。
强大化身由蓝灰色雨云、薄雾、淡墨、水汽和半透明阴影共同构成。整体轮廓清晰可辨，但内部细节若隐若现；边缘被雨水和云雾自然溶解，没有坚硬的实体边界。
它不接触地面，没有脚印，没有实体投影，不是第二只普通动物，也不是简单复制放大的现实主角。它像从暴雨、云层和天空中逐渐显现的巨大灵魂投影，又像被风雨神话化的影子，虚幻、安静、威严而充满力量。
两者朝向一致，动作方向一致，轮廓互相呼应，但不能重叠遮挡。

【环境与天气】
场景是一片空旷、荒凉、被暴雨淹没的自然原野或泥泞小路。
地面布满浅水、泥浆、湿草、碎石和零散灌木。前景草叶被狂风压弯，地面积水不断泛起密集涟漪。远处低矮山丘和原野逐渐消失在灰蓝色雨雾中，形成深远而朦胧的空间层次。
大量细密、连续、略微倾斜的白色雨线贯穿整个画面。近处雨线较清晰，远处雨线逐渐融入雾气。空气中充满水汽、薄雾和被风吹起的细小水珠，呈现真实、寒冷、潮湿而沉重的暴雨氛围。
天空厚重阴沉，不出现阳光、彩虹和夸张闪电。强大化身周围可以保留一层极其微弱、柔和的冷白色光晕，象征尚未熄灭的希望，但不能出现明显魔法特效。

【美术风格】
采用传统手绘童话绘本水彩风格，融合经典二维手绘动画的叙事表现。
湿画法水彩晕染、透明颜料层层叠色、淡墨渗化、自然水痕、明显颜料颗粒、局部干笔触、轻微铅笔线稿、粗糙棉质水彩纸纹理、柔软而不规则的手绘轮廓。
背景使用大面积湿画法自然融合，色彩在纸面上柔和渗透；现实主角的轮廓和面部细节相对清晰；强大化身则使用稀释水彩、淡墨、云雾与半透明阴影表现，形成“一实一虚、一小一大、一暖一冷”的视觉层次。
整体画面不能过度锐利，不能出现光滑、干净、完美的数字绘画表面。保留真实手绘水彩的不规则边缘、纸张颗粒、颜料沉淀和自然晕染。
整体色调采用低饱和冷色系，以雾蓝、灰青、雨灰、灰白和暗墨绿为主。现实主角保留自身天然颜色，并适当增加微弱暖色，使它成为全画唯一的暖色视觉焦点。
画面具有古老童话书插画般的温柔质感，也具有经典手绘动画电影中的叙事张力。整体高级、安静、克制、忧伤、孤独，却不能绝望。

【核心情绪与故事】
这不是普通的暴雨动物插画，而是一则关于成长、勇气和坚持的视觉寓言。
现实中的主角弱小、疲惫、浑身泥水，却仍然一步一步向前；天空中的强大化身威严、自由、无所畏惧，象征它未来能够成为的自己。
让观者第一眼看见暴雨中弱小而狼狈的现实主角，第二眼发现天空中若隐若现的巨大精神化身，最后感受到：即使此刻的我弱小、疲惫、狼狈不堪，我的内心依然住着一个强大而无所畏惧的自己。
电影级画面层次，明确视觉焦点，强烈大小反差，极深空间纵深，情绪自然真实，充满故事感、寓言感和情感冲击力，精致传统手绘水彩作品。

【负面提示词】

items.contentEnglish:
Create a hand-painted watercolor narrative illustration with strong emotional impact and a growth allegory, themed as “the weak real self in a rainstorm and the strong self hidden deep inside.”

[Canvas and composition]
A 9:16 vertical cinematic composition. Everything must exist in one continuous scene, not split into top and bottom panels, not a storyboard, not two separate images.
Only one real protagonist and one spiritual strong manifestation may appear.
The real protagonist should be placed in the lower third of the image, occupying about 15% of the frame, shown in a natural side view or three-quarter side view. The strong manifestation should appear behind and above the protagonist, occupying about 60% of the upper half, creating a strong visual contrast of small vs. large, reality vs. ideal, physical vs. spiritual.
Both must face the same direction, share the same movement tendency, and have clearly related silhouettes and species features.

[Real protagonist]
A vast, empty, desolate field is covered by heavy rain. A young red fox is struggling forward through muddy water.
It is completely soaked, its body slightly lowered, head gently bowed, steps heavy, looking tired, disheveled, small, and lonely, yet it never stops and keeps stubbornly moving forward into the storm.
The movement must follow real animal anatomy, with accurate foot placement, natural body weight, and a continuous walking pose. Wet fur should cling to the body and be gently pushed by strong wind. Its paws should step into shallow water and mud, creating small, natural splashes that show real weight, ground resistance, and a rain-soaked environment.
Do not make it smile, act cute, or cry dramatically. Show fatigue, endurance, refusal to give up, and the strength to keep going through a lowered head, compressed posture, and steady forward steps.

[Strong manifestation]
Behind and above the real protagonist, in the sky, rain curtain, clouds, and mist, a huge nine-tailed spirit fox emerges.
It must have a clear silhouette connection to the real protagonist, but be more mature, strong, majestic, free, and sacred. It faces forward with an uplifted head and an extended body, in a firm and powerful pose, possibly running, leaping, soaring, or quietly guarding, as if it were the protagonist’s true power before awakening.
The strong manifestation is formed by blue-gray rain clouds, thin mist, diluted ink, water vapor, and semi-transparent shadows. Its outline should be clearly recognizable, while its inner details remain faint and elusive; its edges should dissolve naturally into rain and cloud, without a hard physical boundary.
It must not touch the ground, leave footprints, or cast a physical shadow. It is not a second ordinary animal, nor a simple enlarged copy of the real protagonist. It should feel like a giant spiritual projection gradually appearing from rain, clouds, and sky, like a mythical shadow transformed by storm and wind—illusive, quiet, majestic, and full of power.
Both figures must face the same direction and move in the same direction, with related silhouettes, but must not overlap or obscure each other.

[Environment and weather]
The setting is an empty, desolate natural field or muddy path overwhelmed by heavy rain.
The ground is covered with shallow water, mud, wet grass, stones, and scattered shrubs. Foreground grass is bent by strong wind, and puddles are constantly rippling. Distant low hills and fields fade into gray-blue rain mist, creating deep and hazy spatial layers.
Countless fine, continuous, slightly slanted white rain lines run through the entire image. Near rain lines should be clearer, while distant rain should blend into mist. The air is filled with moisture, thin fog, and tiny windblown droplets, creating a real, cold, wet, and heavy storm atmosphere.
The sky is thick and overcast; no sunlight, rainbow, or exaggerated lightning. A very faint, soft cold-white halo may remain around the strong manifestation to symbolize hope that has not yet been extinguished, but no obvious magic effects.

[Art style]
Use a traditional hand-painted fairy tale picture-book watercolor style, blended with the narrative feel of classic 2D hand-drawn animation.
Wet-on-wet watercolor washes, translucent layered pigments, diluted ink seepage, natural water stains, visible pigment granules, occasional dry brush strokes, light pencil linework, rough cotton watercolor paper texture, and soft, irregular hand-drawn contours.
Use large wet-on-wet blending in the background, allowing colors to gently spread on the paper. The real protagonist should have relatively clear outlines and facial details, while the strong manifestation should be rendered with diluted watercolor, pale ink, mist, and semi-transparent shadows, creating a visual hierarchy of one real and one virtual, one small and one large, one warm and one cool.
The overall image must not look overly sharp, smooth, clean, or perfectly digital. Preserve irregular edges, paper grain, pigment settling, and natural watercolor diffusion.
Use a low-saturation cool palette dominated by mist blue, gray-cyan, rain gray, off-white, and dark moss green. Keep the fox’s natural color and add only a faint warm accent so it becomes the only warm focal point in the image.
The final look should feel like a gentle old storybook illustration, with the narrative tension of a classic hand-drawn animated film. It should be refined, quiet, restrained, sad, and lonely, but not hopeless.

[Core emotion and story]
This is not just a stormy animal illustration, but a visual fable about growth, courage, and persistence.
The real protagonist is small, tired, and covered in mud, yet still moves forward step by step; the strong manifestation in the sky is majestic, free, and fearless, symbolizing the self it may become in the future.
Make the viewer first notice the small and battered real protagonist in the rain, then discover the giant spiritual manifestation in the sky, and finally feel: even if I am weak, tired, and disheveled right now, there is still a strong and fearless self living inside me.
The image should have cinematic layering, a clear focal point, a strong size contrast, deep perspective, natural and genuine emotion, and a powerful sense of story and allegory, as a refined traditional watercolor work.

[Negative prompts]

items.title: X 上的 虎小象：“Prompt👇 —————— 浓色马克笔人物画｜把一个真实的人，画成一件有趣的作品 创作任务 以用户上传的照片为唯一人物参考，创作一幅具有当代艺术感的马克笔人物画。 https://t.co/UF4hXPn656” / X
items.summary: 虎小象分享浓色马克笔人物画创作提示词，保留照片人物身份神态姿势，用宽笔大色块简化重组为当代艺术感马克笔画，加入手工质感与幽默手写文字。
items.contentChinese: 创作任务 以用户上传的照片为唯一人物参考，创作一幅具有当代艺术感的马克笔人物画。保留照片中人物的身份、神态、姿势和辨识度，但彻底重新组织颜色、笔触和画面空间。不是给照片套上绘画滤镜，而是像一位有观察力、有幽默感的画家，看过这个人之后，用几支颜色浓郁的宽头马克笔，把这个瞬间重新画出来。画面应当大胆、浓厚、松弛，有鲜明的手工痕迹。第一眼被大色块吸引，第二眼认出照片中的人，第三眼发现旁边那句有点好笑的手写文字。艺术方向参考亨利·马蒂斯剪纸作品中鲜明的纯色关系、简化的人物轮廓，以及色块与留白之间的节奏。文字与幽默参考大卫·史瑞格里作品中简练的绘画、手写短句，以及对日常生活荒诞之处的观察。本次创作应更温暖，不沿用黑暗、尖刻的语气。统一成一种明确的视觉语言：浓色、宽笔、简化造型、真实神态、少量手写旁注。媒介为浓厚的不透明颜料马克笔，大色块应饱满、扎实、具有覆盖感，让人能看见笔经过纸面的痕迹。色彩浓重、鲜明，放弃统一的浅粉彩、奶油肤色和淡蓝背景设定。根据照片里的服装、肤色和情绪，选择一组有限而有力度的配色。通常使用四至六种主要颜色，以一种主导色建立整体气氛，一种对照色制造张力，再用少量强调色点亮画面。构图与背景根据原图提取主要人物，删除无关路人、杂物和复杂环境。默认延续原图的横竖方向与关键动作。构图松弛而准确。背景以一整块主色或两块大的颜色区域构成。可以适度裁切、放大和调整主体位置，但不要把有意义的全身动作一律裁成头像。手写文字：像画家看着这个人，忍不住写了一句。文字应当让人觉得：“这句话是看过这张照片才想到的。”采用轻微反差、一本正经的玩笑、拟人化的小抱怨，或日常生活中的微小荒诞。主句控制在三至八个英文单词，另可添加一个一至三个单词的小旁注。除日期外，文字最多形成两组。时间戳落款在画面右下角或下方留白处，以更小、更轻的手写字落下实际创作日期。最终控制避免写实照片质感、半写实 AI 油画、柔软喷枪渐变、透明水彩晕染、粉彩糖果色、塑料皮肤、动漫大眼、三维卡通、矢量轮廓、满画面黑色描边，以及过度精细的头发和织物纹理。最终画面应当像一幅可以挂在小型画廊里的马克笔人物作品：远看，色块鲜明而有秩序；近看，笔触有停顿、有覆盖、有人的手感；再看，人物仍然是照片里的那个人，而旁边的一句小字，让整个瞬间突然有了性格。

items.title: image2.5人像测试 {角色}，明确成年角色，时尚杂志级低机位 Editorial 角色摄影 × 高级奇幻人像
items.summary: 整理X案例：提供成人角色图像生成提示词，强调人像构图、光影、服装细节和竖版格式。
items.contentChinese:
image2.5人像测试
{角色}，明确成年角色，时尚杂志级低机位 Editorial 角色摄影 × 高级奇幻人像。保留角色标志性发型、服装、饰品、兽耳、武器或职业符号，并转译为真实高定 COS / fashion editorial 造型。人物斜倚、半坐或侧坐，一侧膝腿靠近镜头形成自然前景透视与近大远小效果，脸部位于画面中上区域，微侧头、垂眸、浅笑或冷静凝视。35–50mm 近距离低机位拍摄，浅景深，局部自然越框。背景根据角色设定自动适配为暗色东方建筑、奇幻室内、月夜庭院或高级舞台空间。暖金/柔白主光塑造面部，洋红或角色代表色轮廓光勾勒发丝与服装边缘，少量冷蓝环境光分离背景；轻 halation，真实细腻肤质，干净暗部，高级时尚杂志调色，无短视频压缩感。左上角加入 stylized “V” × 猫元素 Logo，右下角加入手写签名“voxCAT”，服装或配件可加入低调 VOXCAT 织标或金属铭牌。9:16 竖版，画面干净清晰，细节稳定。
items.contentEnglish:
Image2.5 portrait test
{Character}, explicit adult character, fashion magazine low-angle Editorial character photography × advanced fantasy portrait. Preserve the character's signature hairstyle, clothing, accessories, animal ears, weapons, or occupational symbols, and translate them into real high-end COS / fashion editorial styling. The character leans diagonally, half-sits or sits sideways, with one knee close to the lens creating natural foreground perspective and near-large-far-small effect, face in the upper center of the frame, head slightly tilted, eyes drooping, shallow smile or calm gaze. 35–50mm close-up low-angle shot, shallow depth of field, partial natural cropping. Background automatically adapts to dark Eastern architecture, fantasy interior, moonlit courtyard or high-end stage space based on character setting. Warm gold/soft white main light sculpts the face, magenta or character's representative color rim light outlines hair and clothing edges, minimal cold blue ambient light separates the background; light halation, realistic fine skin texture, clean shadows, advanced fashion magazine color grading, no short video compression feel. Add stylized "V" × cat element logo in the upper left corner, handwritten signature "voxCAT" in the lower right corner, clothing or accessories may add low-key VOXCAT fabric label or metal plaque. 9:16 vertical version, clean and clear image, stable details.

items.title: 极简墨线风景小笺：旅行照片对比海报
items.summary: 将旅行照片提炼成独立极简墨线小笺对比海报，保留高保真上方照片与下方轻盈墨线转绘，3:4竖版构图。
items.contentChinese:
将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的「极简墨线风景小笺」对比海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。
整体采用3:4竖版构图，明确保留“上方原始照片、下方风格转绘”的视觉对照。上下区域可根据原图内容自然调整比例，不必机械均分，但两部分必须边界清楚、阅读关系明确，并共同构成一张完整的编辑设计作品。
上半部分高保真保留原始照片：保持地点、主体、建筑结构、人物姿态、自然光影、空间层次和原有色彩氛围，不得替换场景、改变关键物体、拉伸主体或虚构原图中不存在的地标。仅进行轻微而克制的杂志摄影调色；如需适配画幅，可自然延展天空、水面、地面或环境背景。
下半部分使用温润的米白色或自然纸白作为完整底面，将照片提炼为一幅缩小的极简墨线风景小稿。不要完整照搬原图，也不要把整个画面平均线描；应主动筛选画面中最有识别度和诗意的少数信息，例如：一个建筑或地貌结构锚点、一条山脊或水岸线、一株具有姿态的植物、一名小人物或一件旅行物件，以及一至两条天气与空间线索。
删除无关人群、杂乱植被、重复建筑和琐碎背景。转绘主体仅占下半区域宽度约38%–62%，保留约55%–72%连续、完整、可感知的纸白。
线条使用黑色或深灰黑色的细钢笔、干墨与轻微毛笔飞白质感：允许粗细变化、停顿、断续、纸齿、漏墨和未闭合轮廓，使其像旅行途中迅速但准确留下的观察小稿。
建筑依靠少量结构线表现比例，山峰与远景只保留稀疏轮廓，水面、雾气、天空与距离主要通过留白完成；植物不逐片描绘叶子，而以枝干方向和极少墨点表现姿态。避免灰墨大面积铺染，避免画成完整传统山水画或精密建筑制图。
配色以黑墨为主，只允许从原照片中提取最多两种小面积强调色，例如朱砂红、秋叶赭黄、荷花淡粉、苔藓灰绿或渔网暖黄。强调色总面积不超过下半画面的8%，仅落在一个最有记忆点的局部，不做水彩满铺、彩色轮廓或高饱和装饰。
文字应像小型旅行出版物的页眉与图注，数量少但清楚可读。根据照片内容生成一个简短英文标题，搭配编号字段“INK NOTE 01”和一句极短英文观察句。
标题可使用克制的衬线体、打字机体或略带手工不齐的印刷体；文字放在主要留白区域，与插画保持呼吸距离，不压住主体，不使用华丽书法，不生成中文印章、作者签名、品牌名或水印。不同图片只更换标题、编号和观察句，整体版式与字体气质保持统一。
最终画面应呈现真实旅行摄影与轻盈墨线观察稿之间的明确对照；安静、克制、疏朗，像一页从独立旅行刊物、建筑观察册或私人速写本中取出的纸本小笺。重点不是炫技，而是通过删减、停笔与纸白，让原照片中的一个地点、一种天气或一个短暂动作被重新看见。
避免：整张照片直接线稿滤镜化、上下内容完全重复、下半铺满画面、连续灰色晕染、传统国画满构图、复杂树叶、精密交叉排线、漫画化建筑、卡通人物、水彩填色、高饱和撞色、伪中文、复制照片中的招牌文字、作者姓名、水印、电商模板感和廉价复古滤镜。
items.contentEnglish:
Create an independent "Minimal Ink Line Landscape Note" comparison poster for each uploaded travel photo, no multiple image splicing, each photo output separately.
Overall 3:4 vertical composition, clearly retain "upper original photo, lower style drawing" visual comparison. Upper and lower areas can naturally adjust proportions based on original content, not necessarily mechanical equal division, but boundaries must be clear, reading relationship clear, and together form a complete edited design work.
Upper part: high-fidelity retention of original photo: keep location, subject, architectural structure, character posture, natural light and shadow, spatial hierarchy and original color atmosphere, not replace scenes, change key objects, stretch subjects or fabricate landmarks not existing in original image. Only mild restrained magazine photography color grading; if needed to adapt frame, naturally extend sky, water surface, ground or environment background.
Lower part: use warm ivory white or natural paper white as complete base, refine the photo into a miniature simplified ink line landscape draft. Not directly copy entire original image, nor average line tracing whole; actively select few most recognizable and poetic elements from the image, such as one building or terrain structure anchor, one ridge or waterline, one plant with posture, one small figure or travel object, and one to two weather and space clues.
Delete irrelevant crowds, messy vegetation, repeated buildings and trivial backgrounds. The drawn subject occupies about 38%–62% of lower region width, retaining about 55%–72% continuous, complete, perceptible paper white.
Lines use black or deep gray fine pen, dry ink with slight brush flyback texture: allow thickness variation, pauses, breaks, paper teeth, ink leakage and open contours, like rapidly but accurately observed small drafts left along the travel path.
Buildings rely on a few structural lines to show proportion, mountain peaks and distant views only retain sparse outlines, water surface, mist, sky and distance mainly completed through blank space; plants not depict leaves one by one, but use branch direction and very few ink dots to show posture. Avoid gray ink large area coverage, avoid turning into complete traditional landscape painting or precise architectural blueprint.
Color scheme mainly black ink, only allow extracting up to two small area accent colors from original photo, such as cinnabar red, autumn ochre yellow, lotus light pink, moss gray-green or fishing net warm yellow. Accent color total area not exceed 8% of lower half drawing, only falls in one local memory point, not watercolor full coverage, colored outline or high saturation decoration.
Text like page header and caption in small travel publications, small quantity but clearly readable. Generate short English title according to photo content, paired with number field "INK NOTE 01" and one extremely short English observation sentence.
Titles can use restrained serif, typewriter or slightly uneven handmade printed style; text placed in main blank area, with illustration maintaining breathing distance, not covering subject, not using luxurious calligraphy, not generating Chinese seals, author signatures, brand names or watermarks. Different images only replace title, number and observation sentence, overall layout and font temperament kept unified.
Final image should present clear comparison between real travel photography and light ink line observation draft; quiet, restrained, airy, like a page taken from independent travel publication, architectural observation book or private sketchbook. Emphasis not on showing skill, but through deletion, pausing and paper white, let one location, one weather or one brief action in original photo be seen again.
Avoid: whole photo directly line drawing filterization, upper and lower content completely repeated, lower half fully filling the picture, continuous gray haze, traditional Chinese painting full composition, complex foliage, precise crossing lines, cartoonized architecture, cartoon characters, watercolor coloring, high saturation clash colors, fake Chinese, copying billboards in photo, author name, watermark, e-commerce template feel and cheap retro filters.

items.title: 使用ChatGPT image2.5将人物照片抽象成东方水墨线条海报
items.summary: ChatGPT image2.5将人物照片抽象成东方水墨线条海报，保留辨识度、大面积留白、黑线骨架、朱红墨绿点睛并加小印章。
items.contentChinese:
请严格以我上传的参考图为唯一主体参考来源。

首先分析并提取参考图中最具有辨识度的视觉要素，包括：

主体身份与类型
面部或头部特征
发型、耳朵、角、帽子等头部轮廓
服装、配饰、道具
身体姿态与动作方向
最有辨识度的外轮廓
主体之间的关系
原图中具有代表性的色彩
能够体现主体身份的标志性细节

不要机械描摹参考图，也不要追求照片级写实复制。

在保证主体“一眼仍然能够被认出”的前提下，对参考图进行高度概括、抽象化和东方艺术化重新创作。

将主体转译为具有强烈中国东方美学气质的现代抽象手绘线条艺术。

整体采用极致简约的毛笔线条与现代线描语言，通过少量但富有表现力的曲线重新概括主体结构。

线条具有明显的手绘毛笔感，粗细自然变化，带有轻微飞白、墨迹干湿变化与手工笔触。

大量使用修长、流畅、飘逸的艺术曲线。

部分线条可以从主体结构自然延伸出去，形成类似书法运笔、衣带、水流、风、云气一般的长曲线，使画面产生明显的速度感、方向感和东方韵律。

不要把所有结构完整画出来。

允许通过断线、留白、几笔概括、局部缺失和视觉联想来表现主体。

重点保留最具有识别度的轮廓、姿态和标志性元素，其余细节大胆舍弃。

色彩控制在极少数量。

以黑色线条作为主要视觉骨架，并根据参考图本身的代表性色彩，提取 1—2 种强调色进行艺术化使用。

优先允许使用：
黑色、朱红色、墨绿色。
颜色只作为局部点睛，不进行大面积填色。

部分标志性服装、配饰、道具或动作轨迹可以使用红色或绿色长线进行强调。

构图完整但极度克制。

主体位于画面视觉中心区域，可以适当打破常规比例，对身体、衣物、毛发、尾巴、道具或动作轨迹进行拉长和曲线化处理。

让主体像由几根正在流动的毛笔线条自然形成，而不是由封闭轮廓勾勒出来。

整体具有：
东方抽象艺术、
现代极简主义、
中国书法线条、
水墨速写、
传统神话插画、
现代编辑插画
融合后的视觉语言。

画面加入一枚小型传统朱红色篆刻印章。
印章文字根据参考图主体的身份、名字、昵称、角色特征或画面主题进行提炼，控制在 2—4 个汉字以内。
如果没有明确文字信息，则不要擅自添加具体姓名，可使用与主体气质相符的简短东方意象文字。
印章只是视觉点缀，尺寸较小，不抢主体。
背景保持极简。
使用细腻的米白色宣纸作为底色，具有非常轻微、自然、真实的纸张纤维纹理。
不要出现复杂场景、建筑、景物或装饰性背景。
画面四周必须保留大面积留白，尤其主体外围不要塞满元素。

利用留白与少量曲线形成东方绘画中的“虚实关系”和呼吸感。

最终效果应像：

“从一张真实参考图中提取灵魂与轮廓，再用几根飘逸的中国毛笔长线重新画了一遍。”

强调：
主体辨识度必须保留，
但不是照片复制；
结构高度概括，
但不能抽象到无法识别；
线条少而精准，
飘逸但不凌乱；
传统东方气质与现代设计感同时存在。

高清细腻，艺术海报级完成度，干净、克制、高级。

禁止：
写实照片效果、
3D渲染、
卡通Q版、
复杂背景、
大量颜色、
大面积色块、
密集细节、
机械描边、
封闭式矢量轮廓、
霓虹灯效果、
赛博朋克元素、
多余文字、
英文文字、
商业Logo、
水印。

画面重点始终是：
「参考图主体辨识度 + 极简毛笔线条 + 飘逸长曲线 + 东方留白 + 少量朱红/墨绿点睛」。
items.contentEnglish:
Please strictly take the reference image I uploaded as the only subject reference source.

First analyze and extract the most identifiable visual elements from the reference image, including:

subject identity and type
facial or head features
hairstyle, ears, horns, hats and other head outlines
clothing, accessories, props
body posture and direction of movement
most identifiable outer contour
relationships between subjects
representative colors in the original image
iconic details that reflect the subject's identity

Do not mechanically reproduce the reference image, nor pursue photo-level realistic replication.

On the premise that the subject can still be recognized at a glance, highly generalize, abstractize and Orientalize the reference image for recreation.

Translate the subject into a modern abstract hand-drawn line art with strong Chinese Oriental aesthetic temperament.

Overall, use extremely simple brush strokes and modern line drawing language to re-generalize the subject's structure with a small number of but expressive curves.

The lines have a clear hand-drawn brush feel, with natural thickness variations, slight feibai, ink wet-dry changes and manual strokes.

A large amount of slender, fluent, graceful artistic curves are used.

Some lines can naturally extend from the subject's structure, forming long curves similar to calligraphy strokes, ribbons, water flow, wind, or cloud qi, creating obvious speed, direction and Oriental rhythm.

Do not draw all structures completely.

It is allowed to use broken lines, blank spaces, sketchy few strokes, partial missing and visual association to represent the subject.

Focus on retaining the most identifiable contours, postures and iconic elements, boldly discarding other details.

Color control is limited to a very small number.

Black lines are used as the main visual skeleton, and 1-2 accent colors are extracted from the representative colors of the reference image for artistic use.

Priority is allowed to use:
black, cinnabar red, ink green.
Colors are only used as local accents, not large area coloring.

Some iconic clothing, accessories, props or action traces can use red or green long lines for emphasis.

Composition is complete but extremely restrained.

The subject is located in the center of the visual area, with appropriate breaking of conventional proportions, stretching and curving the body, clothing, hair, tail, props or action traces.

The subject is like formed naturally by a few flowing brush lines, rather than outlined with closed contours.

Overall it has:
Oriental abstract art,
modern minimalism,
Chinese calligraphy lines,
ink wash sketch,
traditional mythological illustration,
modern editorial illustration
fused visual language.

A small traditional cinnabar red seal is added to the image.
The seal text is refined based on the subject's identity, name, nickname, character features or image theme, controlled within 2-4 Chinese characters.
If there is no clear text information, do not add specific names arbitrarily, and can use short Oriental imagery text that matches the subject's temperament.
The seal is only a visual decoration, small in size, not competing with the subject.
The background is kept extremely simple.
A delicate off-white xuan paper is used as the base color, with very subtle, natural and realistic paper fiber texture.
No complex scenes, buildings, scenery or decorative backgrounds should appear.
A large area of blank space must be retained around the image, especially not filling elements around the subject periphery.

Use blank space and a small amount of curves to create the "virtual-real relationship" and breathing sense in Oriental painting.

The final effect should be like:

"Extract the soul and contours from a real reference image, then redraw it with a few elegant Chinese brush long lines."

Emphasize:
the subject's identification must be retained,
but it is not a photo copy;
the structure is highly generalized,
but not abstract to the point of unrecognizability;
the lines are few and precise,
graceful but not messy;
tradiional Oriental temperament and modern design sense coexist simultaneously.

High-definition and delicate, artistic poster-level completion, clean, restrained, and high-end.

Prohibited:
photorealistic photo effects,
3D rendering,
cartoon Q version,
complex backgrounds,
large amounts of color,
large area color blocks,
dense details,
mechanical outlines,
closed vector contours,
neon effects,
cyberpunk elements,
extra text,
English text,
commercial logos,
watermarks.

The focus of the image is always:
"reference image subject's identification + extremely simple brush lines + graceful long curves + Oriental blank space + small amount of cinnabar red / ink green accents".

items.title: 雪山之巅银凰仙姬东方神话人像提示词
items.summary: 超写实东方神话真人人像提示词，描绘雪山云海之巅的银凰仙姬，强调仙侠礼服、强风披帛、金色逆光与电影感构图。
items.contentChinese:
超写实真人东方神话电影人像，一名明确25岁以上的成年东亚女性，站在海拔极高的雪山云海之巅，塑造成来自雪域天界的银凰仙姬，整体融合东方仙侠、凤凰神话、冰雪圣女、高级时装 Editorial 与电影概念艺术。

人物拥有清冷精致的东方鹅蛋脸，面部轮廓柔和而立体，下颌线纤细自然，深色杏仁眼，眼神清冷、疏离、带轻微神性；细长自然眉，挺直精致鼻梁，淡珊瑚粉色嘴唇微微张开。

妆容使用极淡的冰雪仙侠妆，眼周加入少量暖橘红/浅珊瑚色眼影，与冷白雪山形成冷暖反差；真实皮肤毛孔与细微绒毛，面部具有自然透光感，不要网红脸，不要塑料磨皮。

人物头发为浓密乌黑超长发，古典高位半盘发与大量披发结合。高山强风从画面右侧向左后方猛烈吹过，大量黑色发丝向天空飞扬，部分细碎发丝横穿脸颊、嘴唇与眼睛附近，形成极强的动态电影抓拍感。

头顶佩戴大型银白凤凰羽翼发冠，造型融合凤凰展开的双翼、羽毛、冰晶与东方金属雕花，银色金属具有真实雕刻纹理和细小划痕。

发冠两侧垂落大量细长银色珠链、水晶流苏和珍珠链，随着强风向不同方向摆动。

佩戴大型珍珠垂坠耳环；额心加入一枚极小的冰蓝/银白宝石额饰。

身穿一套月白＋象牙白＋冰银＋极淡香槟金东方仙侠高级定制礼服。

内层为象牙白轻薄真丝裹胸式长裙，柔软自然褶皱，胸前采用克制的东方交叠结构。

肩部与胸侧覆盖大型立体银白凤凰羽毛装饰、银色牡丹花、金属花瓣和冰晶状刺绣。

外层披着极其轻薄的虹彩透明欧根纱仙袍，材质介于透明冰晶、珍珠薄膜和高级欧根纱之间，在阳光照射下产生极淡的蓝、粉、金、珍珠白虹彩反射。

宽大透明衣袖覆盖银白立体牡丹刺绣、羽毛纹、冰晶纹。

数条超长象牙白半透明披帛围绕人物飞舞，其中部分披帛从镜头前极近距离掠过，形成巨大的奶油色前景虚化。

所有衣料都必须具有真实物理重量与风力反馈，不要静止悬浮。

人物身体呈优雅的三分之二侧身。上半身略微向画面右侧转动。一只手轻轻放在锁骨与胸前衣料附近，手指纤细自然。另一条手臂向画面右上方高高抬起，仿佛正在控制、抓住或穿过被狂风卷起的巨大透明披帛。头部微微抬起，视线看向画面右上方远处，而不是直接看镜头。表情安静、冷艳、略带神性，没有明显笑容，整体动作像电影中仙姬站在雪山之巅召唤风雪的一瞬间。

背景为极其宏大的喜马拉雅式雪山群、冰川山峰和白色云海。远处大量尖锐雪峰穿过云层。天空为非常干净的低饱和冰蓝色。空气极其通透，具有高海拔环境特有的清晰度。远景雪山略微虚化，但仍能辨认真实岩石、积雪、冰川纹理。不要宫殿，不要室内，不要普通树林。

金色日出或傍晚 Golden Hour。太阳位于人物右上方偏后位置，形成强烈但柔和的暖金色侧逆光。阳光穿过透明披帛产生大量柔和折射、耀斑、光斑和珍珠色高光。人物脸部保持柔和自然补光。鼻梁、嘴唇、肩膀和锁骨出现非常细腻的暖金高光。黑色飞舞发丝边缘产生漂亮的银金色轮廓光。银色凤凰冠和金属花卉出现克制的镜面反射。透明衣料形成明显的虹彩折射。大量近距离披帛遮挡镜头，产生奶油白、香槟金色圆形散景和梦幻 Bloom。高光允许轻微溢出，但人物眼睛、五官和部分发丝必须保持清晰。

9:16竖屏电影构图，中近景至半身构图，人物位于画面中央偏左，头部约位于画面上方1/3区域，轻微低机位仰拍，镜头距离约1.5–2.5米，85mm等效电影人像镜头，f/1.8–f/2.2，浅景深。

镜头前方必须存在多层半透明披帛、银白羽毛或冰晶装饰作为前景。部分前景严重失焦，占据画面右侧以及上下边缘，形成偷窥式、包围式电影构图。人物眼睛与脸部为主要焦点，背景雪山自然虚化。
items.contentEnglish:
Hyper-realistic live-action Eastern mythological cinematic portrait of an adult East Asian woman aged 25 or above, standing atop a very high snow mountain above a sea of clouds, transformed into a silver phoenix fairy from a snowy celestial realm, blending Eastern xianxia, phoenix mythology, ice-snow saintess aesthetics, high-fashion editorial, and cinematic concept art.

She has a cool, refined East Asian oval face with soft yet defined contours, a delicate jawline, dark almond eyes with a cold, distant gaze and a slight divine aura, slender natural brows, a straight elegant nose bridge, and pale coral-pink lips slightly parted.

Use extremely subtle ice-snow xianxia makeup, with a small amount of warm orange-red / light coral eyeshadow around the eyes to create a cool-warm contrast against the white snow mountains; visible skin pores and fine peach fuzz, with natural translucency on the face. No influencer face, no plastic smoothing.

Her hair is thick, long, and black, styled as a classical high half-up bun with abundant loose lengths. Strong mountain wind blows from the right side of the frame toward the back-left, sending many black strands flying upward, with small wisps crossing the cheeks, lips, and near the eyes, creating a strong dynamic cinematic-capture feeling.

On her head, wear a large silver-white phoenix-wing headdress, combining outspread phoenix wings, feathers, ice crystals, and ornate Eastern metal engraving, with real carved texture and subtle scratches.

Hang many thin silver chains, crystal tassels, and pearl chains from both sides of the headdress, swaying in different directions under the strong wind.

Wear large pearl drop earrings, plus a tiny ice-blue / silver-white jewel ornament at the center of the forehead.

Outfit: an Eastern xianxia high-fashion couture dress in moon white, ivory white, ice silver, and a very faint champagne gold.

The inner layer is an ivory-white lightweight silk strapless long gown with soft natural folds and a restrained Eastern overlapping structure at the chest.

The shoulders and side chest are covered with large three-dimensional silver-white phoenix feathers, silver peonies, metal petals, and ice-crystal embroidery.

An extremely lightweight iridescent sheer organza outer robe drapes over the body, between transparent ice crystal, pearl film, and premium organza, producing very subtle blue, pink, gold, and pearl-white iridescent reflections under sunlight.

Wide transparent sleeves are covered with silver-white three-dimensional peony embroidery, feather patterns, and ice-crystal motifs.

Several extra-long ivory-white semi-transparent sashes swirl around the subject, with some passing very close to the lens to create large creamy foreground blur.

All fabrics must show real physical weight and wind response; do not let them float motionlessly.

The pose is an elegant three-quarter view. The upper body turns slightly to the right side of the frame. One hand rests lightly near the collarbone and chest fabric with slender natural fingers. The other arm is raised high toward the upper-right of the frame, as if controlling, catching, or passing through a huge transparent sash whipped by the wind. The head is slightly lifted, the gaze directed toward the distant upper-right, not at the camera. The expression is calm, glamorous, slightly divine, with no obvious smile, like a cinematic fairy standing on a snowy peak and summoning wind and snow.

The background is an immense Himalayan-like mountain range, glaciers, and a white sea of clouds. Many sharp snow peaks pierce through the cloud layer in the distance. The sky is a clean, low-saturation icy blue. The air is extremely clear, with the crispness of a high-altitude environment. The distant mountains are slightly blurred but still show real rock, snow, and glacier textures. No palace, no interior, no ordinary forest.

Golden hour at sunrise or sunset. The sun is positioned slightly behind and above the subject on the upper-right, creating strong yet soft warm golden rim light. Sunlight passing through the sheer sashes produces soft refractions, flares, highlights, and pearl-toned speculars. The face has soft natural fill light. Subtle warm gold highlights appear on the nose bridge, lips, shoulders, and collarbones. The edge of the flying black hair catches beautiful silver-gold rim light. The silver phoenix crown and metal floral elements show restrained mirror reflections. The transparent fabrics produce obvious iridescent refraction. Many close foreground sashes create creamy-white and champagne-gold bokeh and dreamy bloom. Highlights may slightly clip, but the eyes, facial features, and some strands of hair must remain sharp.

9:16 vertical cinematic composition, medium-close to half-body framing, subject positioned slightly left of center, head around the upper third of the frame, slight low-angle shot, camera distance about 1.5–2.5 meters, 85mm equivalent cinematic portrait lens, f/1.8–f/2.2, shallow depth of field.

There must be multiple layers of semi-transparent sashes, silver-white feathers, or ice-crystal ornaments in the foreground. Some foreground elements should be heavily out of focus, occupying the right side and the top/bottom edges, creating a voyeuristic, enveloping cinematic composition. The eyes and face are the primary focus, and the mountain background naturally falls off into blur.

items.title: 蓝天背景下的珍珠白流光纱东方幻想神女写真
items.summary: 成年东亚女性静坐于珍珠白流光纱裙中，搭配银白凤凰水晶头冠与珍珠流苏耳饰，蓝天白云背景，整体超写实、圣洁空灵、电影感十足。
items.contentChinese:
成年东亚女性超写实电影级竖版东方幻想神女写真，主体静坐于大面积铺展开来的珍珠白流光纱裙之中，背景为晴朗通透的蓝天与轻薄云层。整体画面明亮纯净，呈现圣洁、空灵、柔和、神性气质。

人物为精致鹅蛋脸，五官柔美立体，眉眼清淡高级，眼神安静温柔、略带距离感，嘴唇自然微启；皮肤白皙细腻，保留真实皮肤纹理与自然通透感，不要塑料磨皮效果。

乌黑柔亮的长发，高盘发结合半披发，发丝蓬松轻盈，脸侧与额前垂下细碎发丝，随微风轻扬。头戴华丽复杂的银白凤凰枝蔓水晶头冠，融合凤凰羽翼、金属花枝、水晶花、珍珠串、垂坠流苏、水滴晶饰等元素，体量大，极具高贵圣洁气质。耳饰为长款珍珠流苏耳坠，轻轻垂落。

身穿月白珍珠色流璃幻想礼服，主色为珍珠白、香槟白、银白、冰透白。礼服由多层半透明欧根纱、珠光流璃薄纱、镜面感轻透面料、柔和叠层大裙摆构成，裙身装饰细致银色花叶构件、珍珠串饰、水滴晶饰与轻奢刺绣。肩袖部分轻柔包裹手臂，礼服自然滑落，露出肩膀、锁骨与上胸线条，整体优雅圣洁。

姿态为坐姿偏斜倚，身体微微向后侧转，肩颈优雅拉长，一只手自然搭在裙摆之上，另一只手轻放在身侧纱面，姿态放松从容。人物被大量铺展翻涌的月白流光纱包围，裙摆如云海般层层叠叠，在阳光下反射柔和银白高光，构成华美壮阔的视觉氛围。

光线采用明亮柔和自然日光，整体高亮通透，服装材质强调轻透、镜面、珠光、流璃质感，画面风格为超高端时尚摄影与东方古风幻想神女视觉结合，呈现“天穹之下的霜羽圣女”气质。

摄影关键词：超写实、摄影级、电影感、成年东亚女性、月白珍珠礼服、银白凤凰头冠、珍珠流苏耳饰、珍珠白流光纱、云海般裙摆、高盘发半披发、圣洁感、空灵感、蓝天背景、自然高光、东方幻想神女、高端时尚大片、流璃质感。

负面提示词：未成年，二次元，动漫，插画，3D建模，塑料皮肤，服装僵硬，头饰错误，构图混乱，现代场景，室内背景，暗沉脏色，过度饱和，低清晰度，水印，logo，文字，脸部崩坏，多余手指，畸形四肢。
items.contentEnglish:
An ultra-realistic, cinematic, vertical Oriental fantasy goddess portrait of an adult East Asian woman seated among a large spread of pearl-white flowing gauze, with a clear blue sky and thin clouds in the background. The overall image is bright and pristine, conveying a sacred, ethereal, soft, and divine atmosphere.

The subject has an exquisite oval face, soft yet dimensional facial features, understated but refined eyes, calm and gentle gaze with a slight sense of distance, and naturally parted lips. Her skin is fair and delicate, preserving real skin texture and natural translucency, without a plastic smoothing effect.

She has long glossy black hair in a high updo with half-down styling, with soft airy strands and wisps around the face and forehead gently lifted by the breeze. She wears an elaborate silver-white crystal crown inspired by phoenix branches and vines, featuring phoenix wings, metallic floral branches, crystal flowers, pearl strands, dangling tassels, and teardrop crystal ornaments; it is large in scale and gives a noble, sacred impression. Her earrings are long pearl tassel earrings that hang lightly.

She wears a moon-white pearl fantasy gown in pearl white, champagne white, silver white, and icy translucent white. The gown is made of layered sheer organza, pearlescent glossy gauze, mirror-like translucent fabric, and a soft multi-layered large skirt. The dress is decorated with delicate silver floral and leaf elements, pearl strings, teardrop crystal ornaments, and subtle luxury embroidery. The shoulder sleeves gently cover the arms, and the gown naturally slips to reveal the shoulders, collarbones, and upper chest line, creating an elegant and sacred look.

Her pose is a seated, slightly leaning posture, with her body subtly turned backward to the side, an elegantly elongated neck and shoulders, one hand resting naturally on the skirt, and the other lightly touching the gauze beside her. She is surrounded by voluminous flowing moon-white gauze, with the skirt layered like a sea of clouds, reflecting soft silver-white highlights in the sunlight and forming a magnificent visual atmosphere.

Lighting uses bright, soft, natural daylight with a high-key, transparent look. The material emphasis is on lightness, mirror sheen, pearlescence, and glossy glazed texture. The style combines ultra-high-end fashion photography with an Oriental ancient-fantasy goddess visual, evoking the feeling of a “frost-feather saintess beneath the sky.”

items.title: 晨花淡紫和服侧坐人像提示词
items.summary: 保守整理为一则日系和服人像生成提示词，保留晨光、花朵、淡紫和服、沙发坐姿、侧脸构图与否定要求。
items.contentChinese:
主题：
晨花淡紫和服人像

主体：
画面中央，一位年轻女性坐在有花朵和朝阳的和洋室沙发上。她穿着白色底、淡紫花纹的和服，系紫色腰带，左下方伸出一条腿，侧脸和胸口为主视觉。

人物与表情：
细长卵形脸，小巧下巴，低垂的淡褐色眼睛，细眉，清秀鼻梁，略微张开的红桃色唇。脸朝画面左下方，神情安静，目光看向左肩指尖。明亮棕色长发在后脑勺松散束起，配薄刘海和脸侧发束，右后方有白色小花发饰。

服装与姿势：
和服从双肩大幅滑落，底色由白到浅紫，散布紫、青、淡桃色菊花和小花，胸口深V敞开。腰间系浓淡紫色织纹腰带，中央有珍珠风花朵装饰。人物斜坐在沙发上，左腿向前伸展，右臂支撑身体，左手指尖触碰左肩领口。

背景与光线：
画面左后方有大木框窗户，透明花瓶中插着白与紫的花朵，旁边有水杯；画面右后方有木制梳妆台、圆镜、玻璃瓶和和纸灯罩的灯。白色长毛沙发与花纹靠垫。左窗射入柔和晨光，照亮脸庞、肩膀、和服与前方腿部。

构图与镜头：
3:4纵向构图，从略高于坐姿人物胸部的正面左侧镜头取景，收录从头顶到前方大腿中央。人物置于中央偏右，左腿位于左下方，窗户和花朵位于左上方。腿部和右臂在画面边缘裁切，侧脸与和服花纹清晰对焦，背景柔和虚化。

质感与风格：
照片般的真实写实风格，自然肌肤、光泽头发、和服织纹与淡雅花样、腰带、珍珠装饰、白色长毛沙发细节清晰，整体为白色、浅紫、木色的明亮细腻晨光。

负面：
肩膀被和服完全覆盖；改变淡紫花纹与坐姿。
items.contentEnglish:
Theme:
Morning floral lavender kimono portrait

Subject:
A young woman sits on a sofa in a Japanese-Western room with flowers and morning sunlight. She wears a white kimono with pale lavender floral patterns and a purple obi, with one leg extending toward the lower left; the side face and chest are the main focus.

Appearance and expression:
A slender oval face, small chin, downcast light brown eyes, thin eyebrows, a neat nose bridge, and slightly parted glossy red-peach lips. Her face turns toward the lower left of the frame, with a calm expression looking at the fingertips near her left shoulder. Her long bright brown hair is loosely tied at the back of her head, with thin bangs and face-framing strands, plus a small white flower hair ornament at the back right.

Clothing and pose:
The kimono-like dress is largely slipped off both shoulders, with a base color shifting from white to light lavender and scattered with purple, blue, and pale pink chrysanthemums and small flowers; the chest is deeply open in a deep V. A woven obi in layered purple tones is tied at the waist, with a pearl-like flower ornament in the center. She sits diagonally on the sofa, stretching her left leg forward, supporting her body with her right arm, while the fingertips of her left hand touch the collar at her left shoulder.

Background and light:
A large wooden-framed window is in the left rear, with a transparent vase holding white and purple flowers and a water cup nearby; in the right rear are a wooden dresser, round mirror, glass bottles, and a paper-shade lamp. A white long-pile sofa and floral cushions are present. Soft morning sunlight from the left window lights the face, shoulders, kimono, and front leg.

Composition and camera:
Vertical 3:4 composition, shot from a slightly higher front-left angle than the seated subject’s chest, framing from the top of the head to the middle of the front thigh. Place the subject large in the center-right, the left leg in the lower left, and the window and flowers in the upper left. Crop the leg and right arm at the frame edge, keep the side face and kimono floral pattern in focus, and softly blur the background.

Texture and style:
Photorealistic real-life photography style, with natural skin, glossy hair, kimono weave and delicate floral patterns, obi, pearl ornament, and the white long-pile sofa rendered in high detail, under bright and delicate morning light in white, light purple, and wood tones.

Negative:
A kimono fit that fully covers the shoulders; changing the pale lavender floral pattern and seated pose.

items.title: 东方戏曲人物水袖绘画：一袖起，满台风月
items.summary: 东方戏曲人物半侧面厚涂油画风格，强调大幅后仰姿态、白色水袖弧形结构、冷白侧光与深墨绿黑背景。
items.contentChinese:
16:9 横构图，东方戏曲人物绘画，干净大色块厚涂油画，轻微水彩湿边，低饱和舞台色彩。

人物位于画面中央偏左，摄影机从她的正侧面略低位置拍摄。她完全呈侧脸，头部大幅后仰，下巴抬高，双眼闭合，颈部与下颌形成一条修长连续曲线。

一只手从胸前缓慢抬起，指尖靠近喉咙；另一只手向身后大幅甩开，带动一条巨大的白色水袖从人物身后向画面右上方形成长而优雅的弧形结构。

水袖不要复杂褶皱，而是由象牙白、浅灰白和少量淡蓝灰三四块大色面构成。

戏曲凤冠轮廓高而复杂，但细节集中在头部。人物面部以暖灰肤色、珊瑚红眼妆、朱红嘴唇塑形。

一道冷白光从画面左上后方照来，侧脸大部分留暗，只在鼻尖、上唇、下巴、颈部与锁骨留下几个干净而醒目的亮色色块。背景保持深墨绿黑色，几乎没有环境。
items.contentEnglish:
16:9 horizontal composition, an oriental opera figure painting, clean large color blocks in thick oil paint, slight watercolor wet edges, low-saturation stage colors.

The figure is placed slightly left of center, shot from a slightly low position on her strict side profile. Her head is tilted far back, chin lifted, eyes closed, and the neck and jawline form a long continuous curve.

One hand slowly rises from the chest with fingertips near the throat; the other arm swings far backward, carrying a huge white water sleeve that forms a long and elegant arc from behind the figure toward the upper right of the frame.

The water sleeve should not have complex folds, but be built from three or four large color areas in ivory white, pale gray white, and a little light blue-gray.

The opera phoenix coronet has a tall and intricate outline, with details concentrated on the head. The face is shaped with warm gray skin tone, coral red eye makeup, and vermilion lips.

A cold white light comes from behind the upper left, leaving most of the side face in shadow, with only a few clean and striking bright color blocks on the nose tip, upper lip, chin, neck, and collarbone. Keep the background deep dark ink green-black with almost no environment.
